005package com.stuypulse.robot;
006
007import com.stuypulse.robot.commands.auton.Auton;
008import com.stuypulse.robot.commands.auton.AutonFactory;
009import com.stuypulse.robot.commands.subsystems.DriveCommands;
010import com.stuypulse.robot.constants.DriverConstants;
011import com.stuypulse.robot.constants.FieldConstants;
012import com.stuypulse.robot.constants.GlobalSettings;
013import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.GyroIO;
014import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.GyroIOPigeon2;
015import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.ModuleIO;
016import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.ModuleIOSim;
017import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.ModuleIOTalonFX;
018import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.Swerve;
019import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.swerve.TunerConstants;
020import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.Vision;
021import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionConstants;
022import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionConstants.Camera;
023import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionConstants.VisionMode;
024import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionIO;
025import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionIOLimelight;
026import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionIOPhoton;
027import com.stuypulse.robot.subsystems.vision.VisionIOPhotonSim;
028
029import org.wpilib.command3.button.CommandGamepad;
030import org.wpilib.math.geometry.Rotation2d;
031import org.wpilib.tunable.Tunables;
032
033import java.util.EnumMap;
034import org.littletonrobotics.junction.networktables.LoggedNetworkChooser;
035
036public class RobotContainer {
037
038    // Gamepads
039    private final CommandGamepad driver =
040            new CommandGamepad(DriverConstants.Driver.DRIVER_INDEX); // model-agnostic controller
041    // public final CommandGamepad operator = new CommandGamepad(GlobalPorts.Gamepad.OPERATOR);
042
043    // Subsystems
044    private final Swerve swerve;
045    private final Vision vision;
046    // Autons
047    private final LoggedNetworkChooser<Auton> autonChooser = new LoggedNetworkChooser<>("Auton");
048
049    // Robot container
050
051    public RobotContainer() {
052        EnumMap<Camera, VisionIO> visionIOMap = new EnumMap<>(Camera.class);
053        switch (GlobalSettings.CURRENT_MODE) {
054            case REAL -> {
055                swerve =
056                        new Swerve(
057                                new GyroIOPigeon2(),
058                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.FrontLeft),
059                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.FrontRight),
060                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.BackLeft),
061                                new ModuleIOTalonFX(TunerConstants.BackRight));
062                for (Camera camera : VisionConstants.Camera.values()) {
063                    visionIOMap.put(
064                            camera,
065                            VisionConstants.VISION_MODE == VisionMode.LIMELIGHT
066                                    ? new VisionIOLimelight(
067                                            camera.getName(),
068                                            camera.getRobotToCamera(),
069                                            swerve::getRotation)
070                                    : new VisionIOPhoton(
071                                            camera.getName(), camera.getRobotToCamera()));
072                }
073            }
074
075            case SIM -> {
076                swerve =
077                        new Swerve(
078                                new GyroIO() {},
079                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.FrontLeft),
080                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.FrontRight),
081                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.BackLeft),
082                                new ModuleIOSim(TunerConstants.BackRight));
083                for (Camera camera : Camera.values()) {
084                    visionIOMap.put(
085                            camera,
086                            new VisionIOPhotonSim(
087                                    camera.getName(), camera.getRobotToCamera(), swerve::getPose));
088                }
089            }
090
091            default -> {
092                swerve =
093                        new Swerve(
094                                new GyroIO() {},
095                                new ModuleIO() {},
096                                new ModuleIO() {},
097                                new ModuleIO() {},
098                                new ModuleIO() {});
099                for (Camera camera : Camera.values()) {
100                    visionIOMap.put(camera, new VisionIO() {});
101                }
102            }
103        }
104        vision = new Vision(swerve.visionConsumer, visionIOMap);
105
106        configureLogging();
107        configureDefaultCommands();
108        configureButtonBindings();
109        configureAutons();
110
111        Tunables.publish("Field", FieldConstants.FIELD_2D);
112    }
113
114    /***************/
115    /*** LOGGING ***/
116    /***************/
117
118    private void configureLogging() {}
119
120    /****************/
121    /*** DEFAULTS ***/
122    /****************/
123
124    private void configureDefaultCommands() {
125        swerve.setDefaultCommand(DriveCommands.joystickDrive(swerve, driver));
126    }
127
128    /***************/
129    /*** BUTTONS ***/
130    /***************/
131
132    private void configureButtonBindings() {
133        driver.dpadUp().onTrue(DriveCommands.resetHeading(swerve, Rotation2d.ZERO));
134    }
135
136    /**************/
137    /*** AUTONS ***/
138    /**************/
139
140    private void configureAutons() {
141        AutonFactory autonFactory = new AutonFactory();
142
143        autonChooser.addDefault("Do Nothing", autonFactory.doNothingAuton());
144    }
145
146    /**
147     * Use this to pass the autonomous command to the main {@link Robot} class.
148     *
149     * @return The command to run in autonomous
150     */
151    public Auton getAutonomousCommand() {
152        return autonChooser.getSelected();
153    }
154}
